meta.title: HR Rebuild Roadmap
meta.head: 5f6713f
meta.eyebrow: hr-automation-rebuild · derived view · single source: docs/roadmap/roadmap.json
meta.lede: The ground-up rebuild of UCSD's UCPath HR automation, drawn as a tree. **Phases 0–2 are complete** — the platform is built and proven; **Phase 3** migrates the 13 remaining legacy workflows one at a time and entered at **separations**; legacy stays the sole production authority until one all-at-once cutover. Every box shows what it **builds** (by layer, filled when built) and what it **needs** — select one for detail, hover to light up what it unlocks.
sources: `docs/plans/2026-08-20-dashboard-architecture-audit.md` (Track D) · doc 07 wins on any disagreement
meta.footer: Derived view — the plan SSOT is `docs/rebuild/07-master-plan.md`, the decision changelog `docs/rebuild/04-reconciliation.md`; `ROADMAP.md` is the prose tracking view. Update all of them together with `/custom-update-plan`. Sizes are relative build sizes (doc 07 §3.7), not calendar.
